scope: All stage-0 tracked regular files matching the basename expression, regardless of directory. No generated files, symlinks or submodule contents. Use Git bytes as committed; keep a selected file in the denominator even when native parsing or binding cannot supply truth.
context: Repository root for top-level Dockerfiles. For nested files, a specific ignore file can be discovered beside the Dockerfile but do not infer a local context from its enclosing directory. No build invocation metadata.
